answer: A farm faking 90 aliases needs 90 separate burn histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Charcoal burner guild record with kiln burn history is the check: burns completed at one kiln across seasons. The sable check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The gale record is public, the voyage cost is per identity, and 90 aliases cost 90 times one honest seat.
